title: Chapter 365
text:
Bang! Bang! Bullets rained down!

There were more than two hundred mercenaries, more than a hundred peddlers, and hundreds of thugs who had joined in the melee. In total, there were seven Grade B's involved in the battle. The dock was in chaos, and explosions rang out one after another. Colorful flames flashed and dazzled the eyes. The mercenaries' goal was very clear — to rescue the captives. However, Blades and Purple Gold were stopped by brutes midway. They met two Grade B pirates and were caught in a fierce battle.

The two of them could not get away. Han Xiao's team entered the battlefield from the weak side and went straight to the root of the problem. They quickly surpassed Blades and Purple Gold's team and approached Peggy. Seeing this, the two of them immediately changed their tactics, from charging to protecting Han Xiao's team. Cerleni yelled, "Black Star, we'll take care of your left and right. Don't worry about the other enemies!"

The battle was too chaotic. It was hard to tell when the Dragon Guards would appear. The biggest mission of the mercenaries was to rescue the captives and then escape. Now was the time to race against time.

The players all displayed their abilities, and like a sharp knife, they opened up a gap. Herlous' Battleship Slicing Blade swept horizontally, and all the obstacles below Grade B were swept aside. It was extremely fierce, and the silvery-white flames splashed out as if they were free.

Suddenly, a burning Pugilist wave came from the side. Han Xiaoxin's mind moved slightly, and the Hovering Shield Shuttle turned into a single-sided shield to protect his body. He was bounced back more than ten meters and knocked away a few brutes. Not far away, a Grade B Pugilist pirate was attacking the Black Star Mercenary.

"I'll deal with him. Don't stop." Herlous immediately turned around and ran toward this person. He reached out and touched the Battleship Slicing Blade. A strong Radiance burst out. He slashed out and fought with that pirate.

All the strong enemies were stopped by his teammates. Han Xiao could move forward without any distractions. Peggy's people were retreating toward the spaceship. They were only a few dozen meters away, and they would be able to board the ship in less than ten seconds. However, there was still a human wall in front of Han Xiao.

"There's no time to waste. I can only use explosive means." Han Xiao's eyes focused, and a dazzling electric current burst out from the inside of the mechanical suit. He activated the explosive ability of the mechanical suit, [Snake — Devil], and his attributes were doubled. He violently blasted the enemies around him away.

Then, he activated the magnetic link between the Assault Armor and the batwing aircraft through neural control. The mounted equipment flew out of the equipment box suspended in midair and quickly assembled on his body. At the same time, he loaded both forms, and his speed increased sharply. Like a running train, his arms swept away the enemies in front of him like shovels and crashed into Peggy's team.

Dong!!

A loud boom resounded! In an instant, everyone was thrown off their feet!

Peggy's subordinates fell like wheat being cut down. The bullets they fired produced countless sparks on Han Xiao's armor and were all bounced away. They could not penetrate Han Xiao's defense for a while.

"Stop fighting and board the ship immediately!" Peggy's body expanded. His clothes were torn apart, and he turned into a pale golden python more than ten meters long. The snake's body coiled around Han Xiao. He wanted to stall Han Xiao with his own strength. He only needed to hold on for a few seconds.

Han Xiao used the explosive energy to push the mobile module to the highest power. The ground cracked, and he rose into the air like a phantom. The mechanical palm the size of a basin grabbed Peggy's snake head in a flash, grabbed Peggy, and slapped him to the ground.

At the same time, the kinetic structure of the kinetic skeleton increased in pressure, and the gear speed soared. Amphiptere's biochemical muscles suddenly expanded, and a huge force poured into the arm.

Bang!

The snake head was slammed into the ground by the palm. Cracks spread, and the snake head was badly mutilated. Its body twitched wildly!

He was only a C-grade shapeshifter. Facing Han Xiao, he could only be crushed. He could not even hold on for a second.

Peggy was dizzy. His snake eyes suddenly reflected the iron fist that smashed down again. A touch of fear appeared in his eyes. The snake body collapsed and turned into thousands of snakes. This was the special use of Peggy's shapeshifting Esper ability. It was also his life-saving method. He had escaped many fatal crises with this move.

Han Xiao's punch missed. He watched the snakes disperse in the blink of an eye and mix into the messy battlefield.

He shook his head. His goal was to rescue the captives. There was no time to waste. He could only put away the idea of chasing and turn to defeat Peggy's subordinates. At the critical moment, Peggy's scavengers lost their will to fight and fled in all directions.

Seeing this, the mercenaries of Blades and Purple Gold were overjoyed. Cerleni said, "Send them back to our spaceship immediately. Don't fight, leave the battlefield quickly."

Snatching the Silvers meant that half of the mission was completed. They changed their direction and now had to return to the mercenary spaceship and leave Floating Dragon Island immediately. The mercenaries changed from attacking to protecting the box of the captives and walking through the messy battlefield.

At this time, five Dragon Guards appeared, and Horlaide was in the leading aircraft. When Peggy was attacked, he immediately notified Horlaide. Knowing that the goods he wanted had been intercepted, Horlaide was very anxious. He immediately spent money to hire a Dragon Guard captain that he knew, and he quickly rushed to the dock in the aircraft.

"Captain Theon, those mercenaries took what I wanted. Don't let them escape." Horlaide looked down at the battlefield and immediately saw the very conspicuous mercenaries. He was so angry that he gritted his teeth. Beside him was Theon, who was wearing the uniform of the Dragon Guards.

Theon smiled faintly and said, "Don't worry, it's just a group of thugs. No one can resist us on Floating Dragon Island. Everyone, fire!"

The subordinate controlling the spaceship asked, "Captain, who are we attacking?"

"All of them." Theon waved his hand and said casually.

The five Dragon Guards fired toward the ground. The density of the golden laser was like a rainstorm. The thugs fell to the ground one by one, and the thugs who were fighting immediately scattered. No one dared to fight back. Even the Grade B Supers only hurriedly ran away.

The cannon fire followed the mercenaries like a shadow. There were mercenaries who were knocked to the ground from time to time. The Dragon Guards broadcast.

"Everyone listen, stop running immediately and surrender, or we'll kill without mercy!"

"Sh * t, the Dragon Guards intervened. We're being targeted!" Porter was furious. He could see the aircraft following them closely. It was obvious that they were targeting them.

The good situation suddenly turned bad. According to the firepower of the Dragon Guards, they would have suffered heavy casualties by the time they reached the spaceship.

This time, a laser shot near the Black Star Mercenary and caused an explosion. A few players, including Li Ge, were blown away and fell to the ground.

Li Ge fell to the ground. His butt hurt. Just as he was about to get up, he suddenly saw a black bead on the ground.

Just now, when Peggy's clothes exploded, the black bead he had obtained from the Silvers also fell out and rolled onto the battlefield. It was this black bead.

"What's this?" Li Ge picked up the black bead, and a notification popped up on the interface.

You have obtained an unknown item. Give it to a special person for a high reward, or you can take it for appraisal.

Unknown item? It should be something good. I just don't know where it came from.
